batting.name: R Dravid
batting.dismissal: c M Vijay b S Randiv

batting.name: AL Menaria
batting.dismissal: c M Vijay b R Ashwin

batting.name: J Botha
batting.dismissal: c SK Raina b SB Jakati

batting.name: SK Raina

balls.text: but it makes no difference, Bollinger bowls a full one and it's dug out to mid-on, no sixes in this innings then and Rajasthan end on 147 for six
clobbered down to long-off, no boundary off this over yet
shorter this time and Binny makes some room and wants to go big over long-on, swings and misses
full again and driven down to long-off, Bollinger hurling these in
full toss and played down to deep cover, thoughts of a second run but the fielder is quick and releases the ball back sharply
fullish and on leg stump, clubbed down to mid-on
driven into the covers, sucessful last over for Morkel
doesn't get it, length delivery, outside off, play and a miss
full delivery, Taylor takes a big step forward and wants to hit that over long-on, but only makes contact with the toe end of the bat and feeds it down Mike Hussey's throat, Morkel on a hat-trick

Rahane walks across his stumps to get hold of that ball outside offstump, He ends up hitting straight up in the air as he tries to go aerial on the leg-side. Morkel takes the catch off his own bowling.
full and chopped to long-off
cut away, square of the wicket, Morkel starts his last over
fullish ball, driven with some force to long-on, that was in the air for a good long while and looked as though it might get to the boundary but didn't
full, slower ball and straight and goes over the offstump, Rahane tries to make some room to play but misses
wide outside off, big swing and a miss,
high full toss, cut away, Dhoni tries to make a diving save but it runs to third man, called a no-ball for height
now he gets the boundary, short ball, whipped away through square leg, the fielder was moved from there as well, Taylor picks the spot well
nice and full and driven on the up into the area where they have just moved the long-off fielder from. Suresh Raina came around from long -on to cut off four
Bollinger back and driven to long-off, just the one
quicker delivery, played back to the bowler
down the leg-side, first wide of the innings
played to long-on
top-spinner with some extra bounce, played very fine and gets the angle exactly right, runs to third man
low full toss, should have been put away but its a gentler shot to deep mid-wicket
lots of air and defended into the leg-side
driven to long-on
whipped to long-on, just the singe
tossed up and defended back to the bowler

Goner! Easy as you like it, Vijay is calm as ever as he takes the catch. Dravid is going for the big shot off the short ball, rocks back and pulls to deep mid-wicket. No century for Dravid today, that a lot of our readers were hoping for.
strokes it in the same area and there's time for two
just a touch wide and there's room to cut that to deep backward point
tosses it up and smacked to long off
swept fine for a couple, that's the end of Jakati and how good he has been today
flat batted to long on
super fielding, cut away, look to get it past third man but its well stopped

Botha's move up the order is also not successful today. He gave himself room to hit that full ball over extra cover but got it wrong, ended up getting a leading edge and was caught by Suresh Raina at cover.
full on legstump, smeared to mid-wicket
Shadab Jakati back, played to deep extra cover
full toss but Dravid only gets one, shimmies down the track and plays to long-off
flatter and pushed to point
tossed up and swept again, Badrinath at short fine leg saves it this time
Botha sweeps and sweeps well, timed well and gets to fine leg, Stephen Fleming on the mic says he would like 148
pushed to deep backward point
Randiv not having much luck today, and he isnt bowling very well either, too short and pulled through deep mid-wicket
Driven to long-off this time
Botha's first run, driven to long on
played to deep mid-wicket
flatter again, plays it to short fine leg
Menaria's time at the crease comes to an end. Shorter delivery and he goes on the pull but doesn't get enough on it and Vijay has to backpedal to collect but takes the catch comfortably in the end
pushed to short cover, flat delivery again
Menaria makes a bit of room for himself, pushes that to point and gets a single to keep strike
does it again and defended solidly on the front foot
tosses it up and Menaria defends back to him
played to deep backward point
wants to play the reverse sweep but misses
chipped down to long-on Dravid doesn't get to the pitch of the ball well, Randiv back after an expensive first over
quicker one, yorker length and dug out to point
keeps a bit low and cut to backward point
Dravid brings up 50 and the crowd appreciate it handsomely. Whipped to deep mid-wicket, Jakati persisting with the flatter ones. First IPL 50 for Dravid in RR colours
mistimed cut shot to deep extra cover
tucked away to mid-wicket, Jakati rushes to field off his own bowling

what a stunner of a catch from Jakati! Watson has hit that flat delivery very hard, straight back at the bowler and the umpire was in danger of having his head taken off if Jakati hadn't leapt in front of him and taken it with both hands.
ends the over decently with a single to long on
not really, as Watson gets an outside edge which flies to third man
dabbed to backward point, some respite for Ashwin maybe
now he gets hold of it, goes back into the crease and bisects long on and deep mid-wicket
he is looking for the reverse sweep, but mishits it to short third man
Ashwin changes ends but it doesn't matter. Dravid pulls wide of long-on, rocks back beautifully, that's a great shot
Dravid wants to hit that over the leg side but gets it to long on
cut to long off, Vijay cuts it out
driven to long-on, Mike Hussey comes around to field
a bit flatter and cut to cover
it doesn't look like it, Jakarti is tossing up and Dravid is making sublime contact, inside out over cover for four
back from the Time Out and its pulled down to long on, I wonder if Chennai will have more energy now
Randiv's over ends the way it started, gives it air and Dravid sends that over mid-wicket for four
stifled appeal for lbw, lots of air in that delivery and Dravid misses the flick
tossed up, Dravid look to flick away but gets an inside edge
pushed to mid-wicket, Randiv coming round the wicket now
Not great from Randiv, flat and short and Dravid cuts it through the covers for a boundary
Randiv comes into the attack and Dravid is improvising immediately. Reverse sweeps past the third man boundary
flicked to deep mid-wicket, good start from Jakarti
gives it a bit of air, Dravid comes down the track and pushes back to the bowler
neatly played to deep extra cover, brings up the 50
full delivery and Dravid wants to sweep, but misses and gets hit on the front pad, big appeal for lbw, turned down
slapped to the man at long-off
makes some room for himself and pushed into the off side
flatter delivery again, pushed to mid-on
now he wants to go big, Dravid hasn't got hold of that as much as he could but there's no long-on and that's four
Ashwin tosses it up, pushed past him and he can't stop it in time
swept past square leg, the man there has dived to his right but the fielding has been sloppy and he lets it through
turned to square leg
pushed to deep mid-wicket, flat delivery
too much width and Watson can lift that over point to third man with some style
pulled away but only gets it as far as mid-on, who has come up for Dravid
fuller this time, driven back to Morkel who stops it
short ball and that's gone over cover, stylish cut shot, pressure building on Morkel
Morkel goes fuller and its driven straight to long-on and the man there fields
short, driven in the air over long-on
short again, defended to point
back of a length, cramps Watson up who pushes off the back foot
driven to point, not much footwork involved there
hits Dravid around the hip, squrits off towards Dhoni and the leg-bye is taken
short delivery, beats the bat
cracked away, front foot pull through mid-wicket
driven to the covers, there's a man there and it looks as though he may have put it down
bouncer, Watson goes on the pull and misses, called one for the over
shapes away from Morkel and its too wide for Watson to play at, he reaches far out but can't get to it
driven into the covers off the back foot
good line, defended back to the bowler
driven back to the bowler, Morkel does his own fielding
bouncer, Watson has to duck under that
full and driven through the covers, beautiful shot on the front foot, well timed
short ball, fended off the elbow and quick running. Bollinger fields off his own bowling, doesn't pick up cleanly
moves across Dravid, no need to play at that one
pulled to long-on, didn't carry to the fielder there who dived forward to field, good effort
decent line and length, defended on the off side
picked up and lofted over long-on, beats the fielder, but doesn't have enough to get to the boundary. Rajasthan start well.
defended on the back foot
bit of movement there and its off Watson's pads to beat fine leg. Ashwin gives chase and dives too early to allow the boundary
pushed into the off side, soft hand, quick running ensures the one
gentle nudge into the leg-side as Watson gets off the mark
there's a slip in place for some away swing for Morkel and he got the smallest hint of that first up, left alone

Hussey is the one that ends it, on the pull again, takes it from outside off and gets it through mid-wicket. What a superb knock he played. Chennai's home record is intact this season, 5 matches and they've won all them.
and now we see it again for no good reason. Mistimed pull shot from Raina, the bat seemed to slip in his hand and get an awkward edge and it's an easy catch for Johan Botha.
oh no we see it, the upper cut from Raina, doesn't do it in the samw Sehwag-esque style that we know so well, it trickles to third man and it's just two
pull shot again, this time to deep square leg, we haven't seen the big one yet
turned down to fine leg, one shot could finish this now.
short again, pulled to mid-wicket, just the one, so we will have another over
driven off the back foot this time into the covers
cut away to point, Watson persisting with short balls
short again, outside off, Hussey watches it
short ball from Watson and Raina has shown a lot of control with the pull, keeps it downto deep square leg
played very fine, run down to third man, Dravid gives chase and hauls it in, could this be the last over coming up?
Hussey back on strike, showing how it's done but only gets it as far as the inner ring
short again from Menaria, Raina is a little surprised by it and doesn't get the pull away as nicely as Hussey did
Hussey is enjoying the pull but this time he plays it along the ground and find the fielder so its just one
and again from Hussey, another long hop and it's pulled to deep square leg
goes for a short ball now, Hussey has his dancing shoes on and pulls that through square leg, there's a gap there and he has picked it
poor ball from Menaria, first up, down the leg side, wide
clipped to fine leg and there's going to be a Time Out now, Chennai have just 23 runs left to get.
driven to mid-off, again Hussey sets off as he hits it, small misfield by Shane Warne and the second run is on
pushed square of the wicket, nice, committed running and the two is on
plays and misses, Hussey comes down the track and can't connect
slower and shorter, but Raina is on top of it, he pulls and makes sure it carries down to fine leg
pushed down to mid-off, they set off immediately for the run even though that was nothing more than a soft push
Warne finishes the over well, Raina looks to steer it to third man but only pushes it down close to himself
driven to long-on, easy as you like it
pushed through mid-wicket
nice footwork and clipped down to mid-wicket
hit Hussey on the body, in the midriff really and Warne is the only one appealing, too much bounce to give that
turned around to deep mid-wicket
short and Hussey tries to cut but mistimes it and there's no run
now it's pulled to fine leg, just ones on offer and just ones needed
pulled again, this time to backward square leg
short ball, pulled down to deep square leg
steered to third man, Badri's father on the mic says his family is very happy because his sone has been in good form
turned off the hips down to fine leg. All technical difficulties have been sorted on my side.
yes he can. Raina has driven to long on for one more. And that's his 50.
pushes a single to the leg side. Over to Raina. Can he bring up 50 now?
what a fine half-century. He's again shredded the wide ball through backward point for another four. Seamless acceleration from the Huss.
cuts him to pieces. That's what they do to cloth in Binny mills. Width outside off, Hussey shows him the way through backward point.
back of a length, Raina drives down the ground for a single
full and wide of off stump, Raina creams it to deep cover for one
on the pads, Hussey nudges square and they get a single.
Raina taps with the turn into the covers and goes for another single.
not Rajasthan's night this. An uncertain call, a potential run-out. The result is an overthrow.
cheeky little chip. Botha tosses it up outside off, Raina leans out and taps it over the infield.
flatter from Botha, from round the wicket, Raina defends. Anti-climax.
The Huss walks out again, gets close to the flight and drives a single to long on.
tough to imagine RR recovering from this over. Raina finishes off with another emphatic blow over wide long-on. Doshi tosses it up again, Raina disposes the ball into the stands.
drops short this time, Hussey leans back and pulls to the deep for one more
Doshi getting a taste of the Dosa. Hussey has danced down the track this time, to another loopy ball on the stumps and he's carted it all the way over midwicket. First six of the day.
he charges out this time and looks to heave, but is too close to the flight and gets a single through midwicket
tossed up and bosh! Raina leans out and smashes a flighted ball over cow corner
swept to the deep for one more
charges out and picks up four
driven into the covers
kept low and Raina tries to cut away, misses and there is an appeal for caught behind
pushed down to third man
length ball, defended solidly
that's wayward from Watson, he has strayed onto legstump and it was helped on it's way to the fine leg boundary.
short and pulled to deep mid-wicket
into the gap at deep backward point, it's up[ to the man on the boundary to save again
steered past the inner ring and third man cuts it off on the boundary, just a bit of a misfield and it's two
and he finished off the over tidily. Nudged onto the leg-side, defensive shot again.
driven on the leg-side again, fantastic start for Warne
driven to long-on
and this time Raina gets it away to deep backward point, the throw comes in flat and fast and Raina has to put in the dive to be safe
similar delivery, defended again off the back foot
starts by tossing it up, Raina is watchful and defends
short and pulled, Raina doesn't get hold of it as much as he could like and it's just one
on leg stump and pushed to square leg for one
there comes the boundary, third man is up and Hussey steers into the gap, just runs the ball of the face, angles the bat, waits for the ball well and 50 is up
short ball and turned to deep square leg. We're seeing pictures of messages on the dug out in different languages, all saying its HOT.
full and flicked away to deep mid-wicket, the thermometer shows that it's now "cooled" to 31 degrees
oh dear, Trivedi! That's the third wide down the leg side.
turned to deep mid-wicket, wonder if the break had any effect on either side, let's see
that gap through mid-wicket is there for the piercing and another single comes. Warne wants a breather, it's Time Out time.
tossed up and defended solidly
flicked away into the gap this time, rolls through mid-wicket
tossed up and flicked away to mid-wicket, there's almost a mix up as Hussey goes down the pitch for the run but turns back in time
driven down to long-off, it's all too easy here
Botha to bowl his third, played to mid-wicket
bouncer again and this time it's played down to mid-wicket

banged in short again and Raina is on the pull. Watson has to make a lot of ground at deep square leg to catch that and had he taken it, it would have been stunning. He gets there, but has to reach too far and can't pouch it.
turned delicately to deep mid-wicket, comfortable running for two
Trivedi's discipline doesn't look great so far, down leg again
short and smoked away! Pulled hard over mid-wicket, lovely shot ffrom Raina
just down the leg side, and it's called wide
whipped off the pads to fine leg
driven to mid-off, its Binny again and the batsmen run quickly.
solid defence again, good stride in, full face of the bat presented. What does Warne do now?
turned to short fine leg, Binny careful not to do anything silly this time but he does, shies at the keeper's end and lets a second run through
defended solidly, on the front foot, no need to get too much more this over
wristily worked onto the leg side
tucked away on the leg-side, short fine leg throws at the stumps at the non-strikers end, hits but the batsman is well safe and it runs away for four overthrows, Warne is livid.
driven to deep extar cover, Watson is down on the rope and makes a good stop
terrible misfield, full and wide again and driven to the covers, that's a howler from Doshi who allows it to go through him and all the way for four
full and wide and driven to extra cover, there's protection there, so no run
banged in short, surprises Hussey who doesn't get hold of it properly and tries to pull away, he connects, not very well and it goes down for two
Raina drives that to long-off and sets off for the run as he hits it
some chasing again, Hussey gets a bottom edge onto the pad that rolls away for one
Shane Watson comes into the attack and starts off with one that is wide of offstump, needs some chasing and Hussey pushes to mid-off
tossed up again and Raina defends with the full face of the bat, success for Botha in this over
full length and raps Vijay on the pads, this was definitely not bat. Botha appeals with one arm and then the other and eventually begs for it to be given and it is.
flicked to mid-wicket and even though its straight to the fielder they are off for one
flighted delivery, defended and there's a small appeal for the lbw, the umpire thinks it was bat first
played with soft hands to square leg
flat delivery, played to short third man
first shot in anger this innings. Too short and pulled away through mid-wicket, stylish stroke to get off the mark. What could Vijay be promising?
pushed onto the on-side
tosses it up and its defended solidly
pushed onto the leg-side, bat and pad from Vijay
flatter delivery, good length and pushed to long on
Doshi to open the bowling, starts with a good delivery
